messages.subject: secrdesignapp 1.3 beta
parts:
I've made a few changes to this Shiny app and it would be good to have feedback on any problems, new or old, before it is finalised. You can run it from an R session with

library(shiny)
runGitHub("secrdesignapp", "MurrayEfford")

(requires shiny, secrdesign, and perhaps other packages).

A related paper by Efford and Boulanger is in press at Methods in Ecology and Evolution.
